source.robots_observation: Nordstrom publishes https://www.nordstrom.com/sitemap.xml. General product and browse URLs are not blanket-disallowed, while /api/* is disallowed except narrow explicit allowances. Internal API workarounds were not used.

pilot_results.offer_scope_note: Two products received style-level offers because current price was visible but no specific live size was exposed. Only the vineyard vines chinos received a ProductVariant and variant-level offer because the public page explicitly showed size 14, Nautical Navy, with only 1 left.

sampled_products.product: Non-Iron Trim Fit Solid Cotton Dress Shirt

deduplication.reason: Nordstrom Item # and Core Product ID are retailer-side identifiers and were kept on RetailerOffer/source provenance rather than treated as global product identity.

image_policy: Official product sitemaps expose Nordstrom-hosted image URLs, but none were promoted into ProductMaster public image fields. Attribution alone is not treated as display permission.
next_scope: Continue Nordstrom only through permitted public sources or an authorized bulk source. Do not infer size/color matrices from separate selectors and do not use disallowed /api/* paths.
